typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{ACTION CODE} as string,
		FACILITY_UID as string,
		{FACILITY NAME} as string,
		{VENUE TYPE} as string,
		ADDRESS1 as string,
		ADDRESS2 as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIP as string,
		{ZIP+4 } as string,
		COUNTY as string,
		{VENUE PHONE} as string,
		{VENUE NOTES} as string,
		{VENUE CAPACITY} as string,
		{VENUE TYPE OTHER} as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_meeting_venue*']) ~> source1
DerivedColumn4 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Facility_Id__c = FACILITY_UID,
		Name = {FACILITY NAME},
		Type__c = {VENUE TYPE},
		Street__c = ADDRESS1,
		City__c = CITY,
		State__c = STATE,
		Postal_Code__c,
		COUNTY__c = COUNTY,
		Phone_Number__c = {VENUE PHONE},
		Notes__c = {VENUE NOTES},
		Seating_Capacity__c = {VENUE CAPACITY},
		Street2__c = ADDRESS2,
		Meeting_Venue__c,
		Id = FACILITY_UID,
		{ACTION CODE},
		Status__c,
		Venue_Type_Other__c = {VENUE TYPE OTHER}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select
AddStatus split((isNull(FACILITY_UID) && in(['U', 'D'], upper({ACTION CODE})))||isNull({FACILITY NAME})||isNull({ACTION CODE}),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, ToSFDC)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull(FACILITY_UID), 'FACILITY_UID ', ''), iif(isNull({FACILITY NAME}), 'FACILITY_NAME ', ''), iif(isNull({ACTION CODE}), 'ACTION_CODE', ''))) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
ConditionalSplit1@ToSFDC derive(Postal_Code__c = concatWS('-', ZIP, {ZIP+4 }),
		Meeting_Venue__c = true()) ~> DerivedColumn4
Select split(upper({ACTION CODE}) == 'A',
	in(['U', 'D'], upper({ACTION CODE})),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(toInsert, toUpsert)
AddADFId derive(Status__c = case(in(['A', 'U'], {ACTION CODE}), 'Active', ({ACTION CODE} == 'D'), 'Inactive')) ~> AddStatus
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_meeting_venue_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_meeting_venue_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
ConditionalSplit2@toInsert sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_meeting_venue_Facilities__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Facility_Id__c,
		Name,
		Type__c,
		Street__c,
		City__c,
		State__c,
		Postal_Code__c,
		COUNTY__c,
		Phone_Number__c,
		Notes__c,
		Seating_Capacity__c,
		Street2__c,
		Meeting_Venue__c,
		Id,
		Status__c,
		Venue_Type_Other__c
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Insert
ConditionalSplit2@toUpsert sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_meeting_venue_Facilities__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Facility_Id__c,
		Name,
		Type__c,
		Street__c,
		City__c,
		State__c,
		Postal_Code__c,
		COUNTY__c,
		Phone_Number__c,
		Notes__c,
		Seating_Capacity__c,
		Street2__c,
		Meeting_Venue__c,
		Id,
		Status__c,
		Venue_Type_Other__c
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Upsert
